text: T14(1) DONE. check_deaths no longer spends a run-wide recv total on both lanes: kt_push_ids/gkt_push_ids/kt_recv_ids are collected per lane and a lane passes only when a [KT] death recv applied=1 joined an objId THAT lane pushed. Added paired regression cases: 'host death never applied' must FAIL host->guest AND PASS guest->host, and the mirror pair. Also found the death lines are rate-limited to 10 per gate per process (KtOn, phase1.cpp:2497), so counts are a sample - the checks are presence-based and a counter of 10 is flagged INFO. coop_report.py --selftest: 18/18 OK; real logs unchanged. T14(2) NEED-MORE, not DONE. Build 280D652169D0 is confirmed on disk (ref/AC4Coop/bin/AC4Coop.asi and dist/builds/REL-280d652169d0.asi, both 303104 B, 12:15:24) BUT no log from it exists: a recursive grep for 'kindrole' over every txt/log returns 0 hits and the newest phase1_log is still RUN-2026-10-29. And the aggregate line cannot prove C21 by itself: phase1.cpp:7798 prints four sums, no kind, role or raw, and soldier/civilian are counted BY the predicate under test (phase1.cpp:3234-3235), so the line cannot disagree with itself. It proves liveness + non-degenerate split only. The tuples (3,1)/(2,2) and the kind=v&7 role=(v>>3)&0x3F packing need per-body output. I added --kindrole to coop_report.py which scores the aggregate now and a per-body [KR] line when it exists; the 3-line emit for IMPL (no new engine calls) and the numbered 3-scene procedure are in ops/QA-T14-C21-probe.md. Fleeing is not measurable: no field records it. Send me a phase1_log with the kindrole line and I will score it.
